rule: Any true trigger voids the current HIPAA entity classification until counsel re-determines scope.

triggers.description: Clinic, med-spa, hospital, or provider partnership involving patient or client health data.
Telehealth, clinician dashboard, e-consult, or share-with-provider features.
Insurance billing or any 45 CFR Part 162 standard transaction.
HSA/FSA flows that depend on medical-care substantiation or clinical coding.
A Business Associate Agreement is requested or executed.
PHI is received from a Covered Entity (EHR export, FHIR/HL7, clinic photos, etc.).
Operator-controlled storage of identifiable health journals, scores, postpartum status, or body photos.
Any public claim of HIPAA compliance/certification without a completed, attested HIPAA program.
Acquisition by a Covered Entity, white-label inside a CE workflow, or operating-entity change.
Calendar review: six months after last signed opinion, or after provisional date if still unsigned.
